justification: New read-only tooling: it captures the live assessment page and checks it; it changes no served code path and writes nothing to the database. Not Minor: it is a gate meant to go red on wrong answers, so a check that cannot fail would be worse than none. Not Critical: no production data or user-facing behaviour changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: No new queries on served paths. check.py --db calls the product's own services.intelligence_brief._permitted_engine_forms (SELECT on lep_land_use_table) to re-ask an absence; capture.py only reads the live site over HTTP.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed Google's first suggestion is the house; it was the street (page 404). capture.py now picks the suggestion that starts with the house number and fails (exit 2) if the page resolves a different address.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No existing check compared two surfaces of one page (docs/page_integrity review R7/R9). Reuses dq_probe_app_defects._number_matches for address identity and follows check_test_quarantine.py's ratchet pattern for the producer lint.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_lint_producers.py tests/test_page_integrity_checks_data.py tests/test_page_integrity_checks_text.py -q -o addopts=
falsifiable_check.fails_when: any check stops flagging its known-wrong fixture (Winston Hills setbacks/terraces/as-of-right; Mount Annan 104% footprint; Fairfield conditional side setback), or the producer lint stops failing on a new copy, or a missing route is reported as a pass.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: YES: the lint tests inject a new council-key producer and assert exit 1; each check has a mutation test that stubs it to [] and fails; capture exit 2 observed live when the page resolved the street instead of the house.

functions.name: capture
functions.input: an address with house number, street, suburb
functions.output: a folder with the page's own /api/ calls (gzip) and the text of 3 tabs
functions.if_none: exit 2 with errors.json; never a usable capture

functions.name: load
functions.input: a capture folder written by capture.py
functions.output: a Capture object with meta, calls and the three tab texts

functions.name: main
functions.input: one or more capture folders, optionally --db for the re-ask

functions.name: main
functions.input: the source tree plus the committed per-file baseline
functions.output: exit 1 if any file gains a producer copy

values.value: 3 of 3 captured pages have >=1 defect: C1=2 C2=2 C3=2 C4=5 C5=6 C6=2
values.if_missing: a capture that fails is exit 2, never counted as clean

queries.purpose: C3 re-ask: does the LEP land-use table cover this zone/council when the page says it does not
queries.where_clause: WHERE zone = %s AND permissibility = 'permitted', LGA matched via _norm_lga

break_it.scenario: The page's first suggestion is a different property
break_it.what_happens: the checks would judge the wrong house
break_it.how: identity check against the requested number/street/suburb; mismatch = exit 2
break_it.repro: python scripts/page_integrity/capture.py /tmp/x '43 McCrae Drive, Camden South' --number 43 --street 'MCCRAE DRIVE' --suburb 'CAMDEN SOUTH' -> exit 2 (no house-level suggestion)

break_it.scenario: A route is missing from a capture
break_it.what_happens: a check could report clean on a fact it never saw
break_it.how: facts_checked() reports it as not checked; no flag and no pass claim

break_it.what_happens: C4 and the producer lint can be evaded by different words or names
break_it.how: documented limit; the structural fix (scope as data, one producer) is in ~/.claude/plans/ce-ui-pipelines-NEXT-PROMPT-2026-10-19.md
break_it.repro: add a row whose condition says 'on the level above ground' (no 'upper floor' wording) to a fixture; C4 does not flag it

break_it.scenario: C3 re-ask of the LEP land-use table fails or the DB is unreachable
break_it.what_happens: the re-ask could silently find nothing and the page's 'not covered' would look honest
break_it.how: _permitted_engine_forms returns an empty set on any error, so a DB outage reads as 'no data'; the re-ask only ever ADDS flags, so a failure under-reports C3 rather than inventing one. Recorded as a limit; the producer itself is in scope of the fail-closed step of the next plan.
break_it.repro: run check.py --db with DATABASE_URL unset: the C3 permissibility flag on Winston Hills disappears

post_merge.manual_verify: run python scripts/page_integrity/check.py tests/fixtures/page_integrity/* and expect exit 1 with the counts above
